en: A vintage postcard featuring a building with two towers, each topped with a flag colored red, white, and green (likely the Hungarian flag of the Austro-Hungarian era). The building is labeled as a 'Hydropathic Institute' in both Croatian ('Hidropatički zavod') and French ('L'institut hydropathique'). The scene shows a group of people in early 20th-century attire gathered in front of the building, with trees and hills in the background. The name 'SAMOBOR' appears at the top left.
